data.name: Suvajit
data.gender_notes: Suvajit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Suvajit is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘su’ meaning good and ‘vajit’ meaning conqueror. It is a name that symbolizes the power and courage of a good ruler or leader. The name Suvajit carries the meaning “Good Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Suvajit usually hope their child will grow to embody good conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Suvajit is believed to bring success, prosperity, and wisdom. It is a name that is often given to children who are destined to become great leaders or achievers.
data.etymology: Suvajit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Suvajit total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: In the Hindu culture, leaders were often revered and regarded as symbols of strength and might. The name Suvajit reflects this reverence, signifying a powerful, valiant, and capable leader whose decisions and actions are for the greater good of his people. This name is often given to sons and is associated with the ambition and courage that is demanded of a future leader.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Suvajit holds great spiritual significance for those who value inner strength and the power of the mind over the body. It is a reminder that no matter what challenges one may face in life or how insurmountable they may seem, with inner strength, focus, and courage, one can conquer anything. The spiritual journey of a person named Suvajit is to wage the war within, conquer the desires, temptations, and weaknesses of the mind, and emerge victorious in the grand arena of spiritual evolution.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Suvajit: One who is victorious in both material and spiritual pursuits, the embodiment of both temporal and eternal success.
